company.name: Synack
company.shortDescription: Human + AI platform for continuous security validation and AI pentesting, powered by the Synack Red Team.
company.description: Synack delivers continuous security validation by combining agentic AI with the world’s most rigorously vetted community of security researchers, helping organizations proactively reduce risk, stay compliant, and stay ahead of evolving cyber threats. Synack’s agentic AI Sara handles reconnaissance, attack surface mapping, and initial exploit validation at scale, while the Synack Red Team applies human judgement and creativity that automation cannot replicate. Founded by former NSA operatives, Synack has enabled nearly 10 million hours of expert testing to protect critical assets, from global financial systems to U.S. Defense Department networks. Synack was recognized by GigaOm’s 2025 PTaaS Radar as both a Leader and Fast Mover, and received Global InfoSec Awards for Market Leader in AI-Powered Cybersecurity and Trailblazer in PTaaS. Learn more at www.synack.com.
